articles.title: Serena and Alcaraz Team Up for a Surprise Doubles Match!
articles.summary: Serena Williams is back! She's teaming up with Carlos Alcaraz for the US Open mixed doubles. They got a wildcard, which means they can play even though they're not ranked as a doubles team. It's a super cool pairing of two tennis legends.

articles.title: A 1,000-Year-Old Knight Found Buried with His Horse and Dog!
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Russia found a rare wooden tomb with a rich man buried alongside his horse and dog. The 10th-century grave had cool stuff like a battle ax, stirrups, and a silver brooch. It shows how medieval nobles shared burial customs.

articles.title: AI Just Tackled 10 Impossible Math Problems—Can You?
articles.summary: AI models like OpenAI's Astra and Anthropic's Claude made progress on super hard math problems, including the Riemann hypothesis. But mathematicians are both excited and worried. You can try these brain-busters yourself—maybe you'll solve one!
